content.comment_body: Is there a way to show the current value of an ON Delay timer while it's counting up in [product_name] Web Editor? I want to display the actual elapsed time in seconds as it increases from 0 to the setpoint, rather than just showing the completion bit after reaching the setpoint.

You can use Parameter-VM-Mapping for this purpose. The timer value is stored as an integer, representing the total time base. If the base is in seconds, then, for example, 5 minutes and 39 seconds equals 339 seconds.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to display the live, real-time count of an ON Delay timer in seconds within [product_name] Web Editor, instead of only showing when the timer is complete or at its setpoint. Some feedback suggests parameter mapping allows access to the timer value, but the instructions are unclear and do not specifically explain how to show the exact real-time value in the web interface.
